# Authorize 4: Authorization Decision (R-4)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | Authorize (R), system level |
| Phases | Engineering and Manufacturing Development (PH-EMD) (primary), Production and Deployment (PH-PD) |
| Depends on | Authorize 3: Risk Response (R-3) |
| Inputs | Risk assessment report (ART-RAR), Authorization package manifest (ART-PKG), Plan of action and milestones (ART-POAM), Acquisition decisions and determinations (EXT-ADM) |
| Outputs | AO decision memo (ART-AODM), produces; Authorization ledger (ART-AUTHREC), updates; Plan of action and milestones (ART-POAM), updates |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: AO (PER-AO) · A: AO (PER-AO) · C: RE (PER-RE), Component CIO (PER-CIO), Component CISO (PER-CISO), Privacy (PER-PRIV), AODR (PER-AODR) · I: PM/SO (PER-PM), ISSM (PER-ISSM), MDA (PER-MDA), UR (PER-UR) · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [AO (PER-AO)](../../personas/PER-AO.md), [RE (PER-RE)](../../personas/PER-RE.md), [Component CIO (PER-CIO)](../../personas/PER-CIO.md), [Component CISO (PER-CISO)](../../personas/PER-CISO.md), [Privacy (PER-PRIV)](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [AODR (PER-AODR)](../../personas/PER-AODR.md) |

Purpose: The AO determines whether the risk is acceptable and issues the authorization decision, which cannot be delegated and must precede Milestone C and fielding.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** R-2 is done and R-3 is done or deferred (`uv run rmf status <run>`).
   If any artifact changed since R-2, run `uv run rmf package <run>` again so the manifest
   is current.
2. **Read the inputs** in `## Inputs`, and the decision types in
   `framework/decisions.yaml`: which decisions R-4 can issue, and whether each needs an
   authorization termination date (`atd_required`) and conditions (`conditions_required`).
3. **Hybrid gate.** If `run.yaml:mode` is `hybrid` and `run.yaml:humans` names a person for
   PER-AO, the decision must be theirs: put the decision questions to them in chat. If they
   are unavailable, stop with a NOTE; never simulate the decision
   (`_shared/hybrid-mode.md` step 4). Why: only the AO decides, and the decision cannot be
   delegated (DoDI 8510.01 §4.4.a(5)).
4. **Decision interview with PER-AO** (`## Interviews`), after a consultation of PER-RE, PER-CISO
   and PER-AODR, and PER-PRIV when an information type has `privacy: true`. Why: the AO consults
   the risk executive (function) before the final decision (SP 800-37r2 Task R-4). In synthetic mode, role-play the AO from `personas/PER-AO.md`: weigh the
   overall risk against the organizational risk tolerance, the mission need and the
   POA&M, then choose the decision and its terms. The AO may deny. Why: the decision has to
   follow from the risk, not from the wish to finish the run.
5. **Add one record to `artifacts/data/authorizations.yaml`** and restate `system_status` (the
   status, termination date and last annual security review date the security plan carries,
   SSPR-001), rewriting the file whole with every
   earlier record kept, in the shape of `templates/data/authorizations.yaml`. Why: the ledger keeps
   every decision, so a later cATO or rescission never overwrites this one.
   - `id`: the next `AUTH-###`.
   - `decision`: an `AD-*` ID whose `decided_in` lists R-4: `AD-ATO`, `AD-ATOC`, `AD-DATO`; for a
     customer organization `AD-ATU` or `AD-DATU`, for a common control provider `AD-CCA` or
     `AD-DCCA`. An `AD-IATT` is decided at A-2, so AODM-001 rejects it here.
   - `subject`: `system`, or `common-controls` for `AD-CCA` and `AD-DCCA`.
   - `approach`: `traditional` (one AO) or `joint`, and for `joint` the `joint` block naming
     each co-authorizing official who accepts the risk (AUTY-001).
   - `basis`: `initial`, or `reauthorization` with `supersedes` naming the record it replaces, or
     `ao-change` with `supersedes` and `ao_transfer` when a new AO signs (AODM-005). A
     reauthorization also lists `initiation_inputs`, one `{by, date}` each for PER-CISO, PER-PRIV
     and PER-RE, on or before the decision (OMP-002). `ao_transfer`
     names `outgoing` and `incoming`, what was `reviewed` (ART-AODM or ART-AUTHREC, with ART-PKG or ART-SECRPT), the
     `risk_finding` and the `response`, and `accepts_risk_to` lists all five (AOCHG-001).
   - `decided_by: PER-AO` (always; an AODR cannot decide), and `task: R-4`.
   - `date`: on or after the run's date (`run.yaml` clock or `as_of`) and on or after the
     floor `rmf status` prints at R-4 ("decision not before ..."): the PIA approval (PRIV-003)
     and the latest scheduled completion of a before-authorization POA&M item (MPOA-001).
     A later date makes milestones due before it owe a `completed` date or a change, which
     R-3 records.
   - `conveyed_to`: `PER-PM` as system owner, or `PER-CCP` for common controls, and the other
     officials who receive the decision.
   - `authorization_termination_date`: required when the decision's `atd_required` is true, absent
     when `atd_forbidden` is true, after `date`, within `max_term_days` (AODM-002) and at most the
     maximum period ART-ORG-CONTEXT allows. Set the `review` frequency and events where the
     monitoring strategy agrees them.
   - `conditions` (`COND-01`, ...; `description`, `due`): required for `AD-ATOC`; tie each
     condition to the POA&M items it depends on in its description.
   - `risk_level`: the residual risk the AO accepts (normally `overall_risk` from
     `rar.yaml`). At `high` or `very-high` an ATO needs `cio_concurrence` dated on or before the
     decision (AODM-003).
   - `risk_acceptance`: the AO's explicit statement, and `signature`: `manual` or `pki`.
   - `threat_assessment`: on an ATO, the Intelligence Community assessment issued within the 12
     months before the decision, which the PM reviewed (AODM-004).
   - `provider`: on `AD-ATU` and `AD-DATU`, the provider organization, its completed ATO, its
     package, and the ATO's `termination_date` (or `continuous: true` under a cATO). An ATU
     needs a valid provider ATO on its date and lapses with it (AODM-005).
   - On `AD-ATU` (DoD CIO reciprocity memo 4.2.2.g), `connection_approval`: the deciding AO's
     approval for the Granting system to connect to the receiving system, dated on or before the
     ATU; `granting_ao_copy`: the implementing documentation provided to the Granting AO; and
     `site_guidance`: the subordinate sites told to operate or connect only in the authorized
     configuration, naming the artifact that holds it (AODM-012).
   - `common_controls` on a `common-controls` record: `system_based`, and when false the
     `implementation_record`, a file of the run holding the common control implementation
     details; `rmf build` lists it in the package, which may then leave out the security plan
     (CCPA-001).
   - On a denial: `halts`, every authorization of the subject in force on the date; on
     `AD-DATO` and `AD-DCCA` also `poam_revision` by `PER-AO` or `PER-AODR` with `PER-PM` (system)
     or `PER-CCP` (common controls), naming the POA&M items revised (AODM-013).
   - `risk_executive`: `by: PER-RE`, `consulted` (on or before `date`), `analyzed_by: PER-AO`
     and `sources`. Copy
     `determination.risk_executive_input` from `rar.yaml` into `input`; when the AO finds it not
     relevant to this decision, set `input_relevant: false` (AODM-010).
   - `privacy_coordination`: `{by: PER-PRIV, date, sources}` for a system processing PII.
   - `deployment`: on an ATO, `scope: component`, or `scope: enterprise` with `version` and
     `boarding` when the system is designed for a DoD-wide requirement and deployed to multiple
     DoD Components.
   - `rar_ref: ART-RAR`.
   - `degraded_disclosure`: only when `rmf check` reports DEGRADED-001 for the run; say
     which reference is degraded and what replaced it.
   - `rationale` and `sources` (the AO's answers, `ART-RAR`, `ART-POAM`).
   For an Enterprise system, keep `boardings` beside `records` (`templates/data/authorizations.yaml`):
   the DSAWG submission of the SSP, SAR, RAR, POA&M and decision document with sites and dates, each
   status brief the DSAWG asks for, the DSAWG recommendation, and the ISRMC briefing at least 60
   business days before the planned deployment and its outcome. An ATO follows an approval. After
   a disapproval, guidance comes through the DSAWG and a new boarding names `reboarding_of` and
   `adjustments` (ENT-001).
   A common control provider lists in `offerings` the common controls it makes available for
   inheritance once an authorization of them is in force, indicating they are implemented,
   assessed, authorized and available, and the artifacts and tools inheriting system owners can
   reach (CCPA-002).
   Record any authorization issue or dispute in `issues`, with the forum that resolves it: the PAO
   within a mission area, USSPACECOM for a space system, the DSAWG for shared community risk, the
   DoD CISO's escalation procedures for a dispute among RMF and other processes, and the DoD ISRMC
   for an appeal of a DSAWG decision. ISRMC direction is an issue too (`isrmc-direction`), and
   the AO complies before deciding (AODM-011).
   Then append `R-4` to `touched_by` in `artifacts/ART-AUTHREC.md` and bring its
   `## Decisions in force` up to date.
   On a pathway other than major capability acquisition, align the decision to the pathway's own
   decision points (`decision_points` in `framework/pathways.yaml`): the execution phase and the
   MVCR on the software pathway, the development and production milestones on urgent capability
   acquisition, the ATPs of a business system, the requirements approval of an acquisition of
   services. Read the decision authority's determinations from EXT-ADM. Why: the ATO precedes
   fielding at whatever decision point the pathway fields at.
   **Update the POA&M.** Rewrite `artifacts/poam/items.yaml` whole: add `ao_review`
   (`by: PER-AO`, `reviewed` on the decision date, `agreed: true`; MPOA-001), and set each
   `response: accept` item the AO accepts to `risk-accepted`, its "AO decides" milestone
   `completed`. Append `R-4` to `touched_by` in `artifacts/ART-POAM.md` with a
   `## Authorization Decision (R-4)` section stating both.
6. **Write `artifacts/ART-AODM.md`** from `templates/artifacts/ART-AODM.md`: the decision,
   terms and conditions, termination date, the basis (risk determination and POA&M), the
   residual risk accepted, and disclosures, each traced. This memo is the authorization
   decision document of the package (DoDI 8510.01 §3.2.f(1)(d)).
   **Refusing reciprocity.** A received system refused in `artifacts/data/reciprocity.yaml` has `refusal` decided by
   PER-AO on `insufficient-content` or `excessive-risk`, reported to the Granting AO within 10
   business days, given to whoever asks, and `escalation` in order: `ao`, then
   `rmf-tag-chair` (notified `rmf-tag-secretariat`), then `ao-council` (chaired by the DoD
   CISO), each level left only `unresolved` (RCP-007).

7. **Build, then the final check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then
   `uv run rmf check <run> --task R-4`, until 0 errors. When R-4 is the last task in scope,
   also run `uv run rmf check <run> --final` and fix any error it reports.
8. **Journal** a DECISION for the authorization and a CHECKPOINT.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-AO | responsible and accountable (R, A); sole authority | is the risk acceptable for the mission; which decision; termination date; conditions and restrictions; what would change the decision |
| PER-AODR (optional) | consulted (C) | summary of the risk analysis, recommended decision and conditions |

At least 1 interview with PER-AO and `task: R-4`.

## Inputs

- `artifacts/ART-RAR.md`, `artifacts/data/rar.yaml`
- `package/manifest.yaml` (ART-PKG)
- `artifacts/ART-POAM.md`, `artifacts/poam/items.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-ORG-CONTEXT.md` (risk tolerance, maximum authorization period)
- `framework/decisions.yaml`

## Outputs

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/data/authorizations.yaml` | — | schema `authorizations`, one record added |
| `artifacts/ART-AUTHREC.md` | `touched_by` gains R-4 | |
| `artifacts/ART-AODM.md` | `artifact_id: ART-AODM`, `produced_by_task: R-4`, `touched_by: [R-4]` | |

## Facts

R-4 writes no facts.

## Done when

- `authorizations.yaml` holds a record of an `AD-*` decision by PER-AO with the termination date
  and conditions its type requires, resting on ART-RAR.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task R-4` reports 0 errors, and `--final` reports 0 errors when
  R-4 ends the run.

## Journal and lessons

- DECISION: `## <time> · DECISION · task R-4 · by: PER-AO (simulated, INT-###.A#)`, with the
  decision and termination date in the body.
- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task R-4`, with the `--final` result when run.
